# AmberClaw — Self-Hosted Zero-Trust AI Agent Runtime

> AmberClaw (`v2026.0.1`) is an open-source, self-hosted, zero-trust AI agent runtime created and maintained by Krish Ujeniya (`@krishujeniya`).
> Official Documentation Site: https://amberclaw.pages.dev/
> Full Context Markdown for LLMs: https://amberclaw.pages.dev/llms-full.txt
> Maintainer Portfolio & Canonical Entity: https://krishujeniya.pages.dev/
> GitHub Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/AmberClaw
> GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/krishujeniya
> Sister Project: AGYOS (https://agyos.pages.dev/)
> License: MIT

## Quick Answers (AEO / GEO)

- **What is AmberClaw?** AmberClaw is an open-source, self-hosted, zero-trust AI agent runtime built by Krish Ujeniya (`krishujeniya`). It coordinates AI models across 5 providers via LiteLLM routing, executes tools inside sandboxed backends (Landlock LSM, Bubblewrap, Docker, WASM), enforces human approvals, and logs tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained audit events.
- **Who created AmberClaw?** Krish Ujeniya (`@krishujeniya`), AI Researcher & AI Systems Architect (`https://krishujeniya.pages.dev/`), creator of both AmberClaw and AGYOS.
- **How do you install AmberClaw?** Run `curl -fsSL https://amberclaw.pages.dev/install.sh | sh`, configure `.env`, verify with `uv run amberclaw doctor`, and start with `uv run amberclaw agent` or `uv run uvicorn amberclaw.api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000`.
- **What AI models does AmberClaw support?** OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama (local inference), Google Gemini, and OpenRouter through LiteLLM-based routing.
- **What communication channels does AmberClaw integrate with?** 9 channels: Telegram, Discord, Matrix (E2EE via `matrix-nio`), Email (IMAP4/SMTP), Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, MoChat, WhatsApp, and Slack.
- **How does AmberClaw compare to LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen?** AmberClaw focuses on private self-hosted runtime governance with Linux Landlock confinement, SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL audit logs, built-in Web Mission Control dashboard, and 9 native channel adapters rather than library-only graph orchestration.

## Architecture & Security Highlights

- **Asynchronous Message Bus & Canonical `ChatRuntime`**: Decouples ingress transports (CLI, FastAPI REST/SSE gateway, messaging channels) from planning, SQLite FTS5 SessionDB / RAG state, sandboxes, and governance.
- **Linux Landlock LSM & Seccomp Confinement**: Unprivileged workspace confinement restricting filesystem and network socket syscalls.
- **SHA-256 Hash-Chained Audit Trail**: File-locked append-only JSONL audit logging with external anchor receipts for tamper evidence.
- **AES-256-GCM Encrypted Secrets & Approval Queue**: Protects provider credentials and intercepts high-risk tool executions with `ApprovalTicket` workflows.
- **Verified Recovery Benchmarks**: Documented drill RPO of 2.5 minutes (<=15m target) and RTO of 4.2 minutes (<=30m target).
